verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a deployment/hosting platform, since some platforms of this kind ship self-hostable editions, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Netlify offering a self-hostable or on-prem version of its platform; it presents only managed hosting. The CLI's local dev server is a developer tool, not a self-hosted deployment of the core product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
